name: graph
description: A scrolling history graph drawn with braille or block characters, like the CPU graph of btop.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to plot over time

config.name: style
config.label: Style
config.description: Braille fits two values per character and four steps per line like btop, blocks fits one value per character and eight steps per line

config.name: min
config.label: Min Value
config.description: The value at the bottom of the graph. Defaults to 0

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: The value at the top of the graph. If not set, percentages use 100 and other metrics use the highest recorded value

config.name: hide_header
config.label: Hide Header
config.description: Hides the line with the label and the current value above the graph

config.name: label
config.label: Label
config.description: The label in the header. Defaults to the metric name

config.name: hide_unit
config.label: Hide Unit
config.description: Shows the current value in the header without its unit

config.name: precision
config.label: Precision
config.description: The number of decimal places of the current value. If not set, it is chosen based on the value

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: Use a monospace font for the best result. Defaults to Cascadia Mono, Consolas or the system monospace font

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels. Smaller fonts give a finer graph

config.name: theme
config.label: Theme
config.description: Color uses the htop and btop palette. Monochrome draws everything in one text color with reverse video headers, like plain top. Colors you set yourself are kept

config.name: text_color
config.label: Label
config.description: The color of the label in the header

config.name: value_color
config.label: Value
config.description: The color of the current value in the header

config.name: background_color
config.label: Background
config.description: The background color of the widget

config.name: color_mode
config.label: Color Mode
config.description: Gradient fades from the low color at the bottom to the critical color at the top, Threshold draws hard color bands at the thresholds, Solid always uses the low color

config.name: color
config.label: Low Color
config.description: The color at the bottom of the graph

config.name: warning_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Height in percent at which the threshold mode switches to the warning color. Defaults to 50

config.name: warning_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color in the middle of the graph

config.name: critical_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Height in percent at which the threshold mode switches to the critical color. Defaults to 80

config.name: critical_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color at the top of the graph
